title: 🔆🔅Yasuj, Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad Province — October 12, 2026
text:
🔆🔅Yasuj, Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad Province — October 12, 2026"

" The “Janfadayan-e Iran” (Devotees of Iran) drill was held in Yasuj with the participation of various segments of the public in huge numbers."

"At this public gathering, Iranian drones were displayed, and people carrying the Iranian flag and banners bearing the slogans “The Firm Slap of the Iranian People to the US” and “Death to America” walked over the U.S. and Israeli flags.
